description: This Java source file defines a Fragment subclass named LogFragment, which manages a LogView component for displaying log data within an Android app. It includes methods for inflating the view hierarchy, setting up a scrollable log display, and handling text change events to keep the log scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a scrollable log view for outputting log data, utilizing LogView component and handling text updates to auto-scroll.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applying padding, typeface, and layout parameters.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the view hierarchy, inflates the log view, and adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
